hero-invierno.papel: Héroe principal con espacio negativo para la disponibilidad.
hero-invierno.prompt: Fotografía editorial documental panorámica de un camping mediterráneo de larga estancia en una mañana luminosa de enero. Una avenida tranquila reúne autocaravanas europeas genéricas en parcelas amplias, setos bajos, pinos maduros y un almendro en flor; se percibe vida cotidiana sin mostrar personas. Suelo firme, luz baja cálida, cielo azul pálido y espacio negativo amplio a la izquierda para texto. Ninguna persona, texto, logotipo, bandera, matrícula legible, nieve, piscina, playa, lujo, palmera tropical, HDR ni saturación excesiva.

hero-comunidad.papel: Héroe secundario y página no encontrada.
hero-comunidad.prompt: Fotografía editorial documental panorámica de la plaza común de un camping de larga estancia mediterráneo a media mañana de invierno. Mesas de madera vacías bajo una pérgola sencilla, bicicletas genéricas aparcadas, macetas de romero y una recepción baja al fondo; autocaravanas discretas sugieren una comunidad estable. Composición serena con espacio negativo. Ninguna persona, palabra, número, logotipo, bandera, matrícula legible, decoración navideña, resort, lujo, HDR ni colores neón.

parcela-llevant.papel: Tarjeta y ficha de Parcela Llevant.

Ninguna persona, logotipo, toldo con marca, césped artificial, piscina, nieve, glamping, resort o HDR.

bungalow-olivera.papel: Tarjeta y ficha de Bungalow Olivera.

estudio-garbi.papel: Tarjeta y ficha de Estudio Garbí.
estudio-garbi.prompt: Fotografía arquitectónica editorial de un estudio modular para dos en el mismo camping mediterráneo de larga estancia. Fachada de madera termotratada y estuco claro, una gran ventana proporcionada, porche pequeño resguardado y banco exterior; romero, grava y luz de final de tarde invernal. instalacion-recepcion.papel: Recepción preparada para estancias de varios meses.

Espacio de trabajo realista, luz natural. Ninguna persona, rostro, texto, papel legible, logotipo, pantalla encendida, lujo, cola ni HDR.

instalacion-salon.papel: Salón común de la comunidad invernal.
instalacion-salon.prompt: Fotografía editorial documental de un salón común sencillo en un camping mediterráneo de invierno, vacío antes de una actividad. Mesas móviles, sillas cómodas sin aspecto institucional, estantería con juegos sin texto legible, cafetera doméstica apagada y puertas de vidrio hacia una terraza soleada. Materiales honestos y uso cotidiano. Ninguna persona, letras, logotipos, televisión encendida, decoración navideña, hotel, lujo, fiesta, HDR ni saturación.

textura-lona.prompt: Primer plano editorial documental horizontal de lona de avance color verde gris ligeramente gastada, cuerda trenzada, una pinza de madera y flores de almendro caídas sobre una mesa de madera clara. Textura real, luz lateral suave y composición abstracta. Sin personas, manos, letras, símbolos, logotipos, estampado de marca, brillo plástico, efectos digitales ni HDR.

vida-llegada.papel: Instalación ordenada de residentes para una estancia de 45 noches.
vida-llegada.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: human editorial scene for the Camping Sol d'Hivern demo website
Primary request: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph of two long-stay residents aged roughly 65–80 calmly organising a sunny Migdia pitch for a forty-five-night winter stay at the same modest Mediterranean campsite.
Input images: parcela-migdia.webp provides the broad firm pitch, generic white motorhome, neutral sheltered awning, flowering young almond tree, clear manoeuvre area and low winter sun reference; improve its material realism without reproducing the vehicle ends, any visible licence plate or red bollards.
Scene/backdrop: One clearly bounded long-stay pitch with the plain mid-side of a generic motorhome and a small neutral awning; the access lane, utility point, tree roots and vehicle manoeuvre remain clear.
Subject: One resident slides exactly one low closed storage box fully beneath the awning while the other positions exactly one open plain folding chair beside the existing outdoor table; both focus on the task and neither faces the camera.
Style/medium: Natural editorial documentary photography, 35 mm lens, restrained winter cream, sage, pale gravel and faded canvas palette, subtle film grain.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2 broadside view facing the completely blank middle side panel of the motorhome; crop out both the front cab and the entire rear end so no bumper, light cluster, badge or plate can appear. Pitch organisation and winter light dominate; people occupy 14–24 percent and remain in the central 70 percent for mobile crop.
Lighting/mood: Mild January morning, settled and practical rather than holiday advertising.
Constraints: The chair is fully open and upright beside the table. Both residents, box and chair stay fully inside the pitch; plausible hands and chair joints; anonymous side/back views; visible motorhome panel completely blank with no badge, characters, number, flag or licence plate; no object tied to a tree or placed in the lane.
Avoid: any visible front or rear vehicle end, bumper, light cluster, plate recess, folded or collapsed chair, permanent shed, fence extension, clutter, satellite-dish brand, flag, welcome sign, cable across lane, rug outside awning, fire, snow, pool, readable text, logos, frontal smiles, extra fingers, resort styling, HDR, watermark.

vida-recepcion.papel: Recogida cotidiana de correo y paquetería en recepción.
vida-recepcion.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: human editorial scene for the Camping Sol d'Hivern demo website
Primary request: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph of a routine parcel handover at the year-round reception of the same Mediterranean long-stay campsite.
Input images: instalacion-recepcion.webp provides the olive-green room, long wooden counter, dark abstract cubbies, wide window toward motorhomes and practical low-key workspace reference; remove all papers, notices, labels and pseudo lettering from the generated scene.
Scene/backdrop: The modest reception remains recognisable, tidy and naturally lit; abstract cubbies and a single plain mail basket suggest long-stay operations without readable identifiers.
Subject: A receptionist aged roughly 40–65 passes exactly one small unlabelled kraft-paper parcel across the counter to one resident aged roughly 65–80; both hold opposite sides of the parcel naturally and the resident carries no other object.
Style/medium: Natural editorial documentary photography, 50 mm lens, restrained olive, warm wood, cream and soft winter-blue palette, subtle film grain.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2, waist-up exchange with counter, cubbies and exterior window visible; people occupy no more than 35 percent and stay in the central 70 percent.
Lighting/mood: Quiet late morning, familiar and administrative rather than concierge service.
Constraints: Exactly one parcel total, blank on every visible face; plausible hands and parcel contact; anonymous non-frontal faces; plain unbranded clothing; counter and clear entrance remain visible.
Avoid: label, barcode, handwriting, readable notice, pseudo text, computer screen, passport, payment, signature, uniform, queue, hotel desk, logo, extra fingers, luxury reception, HDR, watermark.

Constraints: Exactly four people at one table; plausible seated anatomy, hands and tile contact; anonymous side/back views; all chairs remain within the table zone; doorway and accessible passage stay clear.

vida-entorno.papel: Movilidad cotidiana de residentes entre almendros y pueblo.
vida-entorno.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: human editorial scene for the Camping Sol d'Hivern demo website
Primary request: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph of two long-stay residents aged roughly 60–75 riding upright utility bicycles on a flat separated greenway between flowering almond terraces in late January.
Input images: entorno-almendros.webp provides the pale winter sky, flowering almond trees, dry-stone terraces, aromatic scrub, low Mediterranean ridge and mild clear light reference; replace the unsafe open road with a plausible compacted public greenway separated from any vehicle lane.
Scene/backdrop: A continuous firm greenway curves gently between almond terraces; low stone edges protect the cultivated ground and no motor traffic shares the surface.
Subject: Two residents ride away at an easy everyday pace on ordinary step-through bicycles, each with exactly two plain rear panniers and a correctly fitted plain helmet; no sports kit and no daypacks.
Style/medium: Natural editorial documentary photography, 35 mm lens, restrained almond white, pale earth, sage and soft winter-blue palette, subtle film grain.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2, path, flowering terraces and low ridge dominate; riders occupy 12–22 percent and remain in the central 60 percent for mobile crop, with all four wheels fully visible.
Lighting/mood: Mild late-morning winter light, practical trip toward town rather than a cycling holiday.
Constraints: Plausible step-through frames, circular wheels, pedals, hands and upright posture; anonymous back views; safe spacing; all four wheels stay on the greenway; exactly four panniers total, two matched panniers per bicycle.
Avoid: racing kit, mountain bike, cargo trailer, electric-bike branding, car, shared traffic lane, orchard shortcut, blossom picking, readable sign, logos, frontal pose, malformed bicycles, duplicate wheels, extra limbs, beach, resort, HDR, saturation, watermark.
